choices.content: Use subtraction: subtract one addend from the sum and check whether the result equals the other addend.
Multiply the two addends together again.
Look only at the ones column and ignore the other place values.

question.prompt: After completing written addition, what method is commonly used to check the answer?

solutions.explanation: Subtraction is commonly used to check addition: subtracting one addend from the sum should give the other addend.
solutions.title: Checking addition with subtraction
